name: inbox.chat-mute-state
description: Read the reminder/mute state of exactly one native chat. The request contains one chat ID only; the projection returns only that ID and muted as 0 or 1. Parent must verify the chat is the signed-in user's approved self-chat before using this state for a mutation.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Canonical native chat ID for the one preflighted self-chat.

evidence.snippet: Generated chats.PullChatSettingsRequest declares repeated chatIds; PullChatsByIds likewise declares repeated chatIds and is used here with exactly one ID.
Generated chats.PullChatsByIdsResponse has chats map keyed by chat ID with entities.Chat values.
Generated entities.ChatSetting.isRemind is Boolean and defaults true; false is the native muted state.
Native command table maps 64 to chats.PullChatsByIdsRequest and chats.PullChatsByIdsResponse.
